Hey PDX network: anyone know a TouchDesigner dev who's free for a 3-week gig?

It's a real project with a real deadline, starting soon, and I'd rather hand it to someone good than let it sit in my inbox.

Hit me up or drop a comment. Let's chat!

Was back in Pittsburgh for the holidays and finally got a tour of a maker space up in Lawrenceville — laser cutters, a full wood shop, a wall of 3D printers still running at 9pm on a Tuesday.

Talked to a couple of the folks in there working on their own projects and, not gonna lie, it made me a little jealous I don't have a shop like that five minutes from my old apartment.

Cool space, cooler people. 🤘

I've been quietly working on something for Bracket Bear the past few weeks... more very soon.

#bracketbear2026

Most experiential agencies are sitting on a platform problem, and nobody wants to admit it.

Why?

Because everyone's budget goes to the next build, and the CMS holding it all together is duct tape from three projects ago. I've spent years now building and rebuilding these systems, and it's always the same story — the platform gets touched last and trusted LEAST.

That's backwards. The platform is the thing that makes every future project cheaper, not the thing you starve to ship the next one.

Maybe I should just start billing agencies for the CMS work they keep avoiding. Half joking. Mostly not. 🧐
Congrats on the promotion — you earned it. 🎉
